rationale: Two off-route segments (RD-1). Segment 1 (14:10–14:13, +1.63 km, the loop round by Cavenagh Road) is exempt: the driver proposed 'go round by Cavenagh' at 14:01 and the rider agreed at 14:02, before the segment started (RD-5), and Orchard Road shows an Accident incident on the optimal route plus speed band 1 (RD-4). Segment 2 (14:17–14:29, +2.83 km) contains the 7-Eleven stop on Beach Road, 1.55 km off the route; the rider asked for 'a 7-Eleven on the way' without naming a place and the driver never said he would drive out to Beach Road, so the segment is not exempt (RD-3(b), RD-5 scope). Refund = 2.83 km x $1.41/km = $3.99 (RD-2). The 4.15 min stop is billed as RydeTAXI meter waiting ($1.08) and stays (RD-3(c)). No flag: driver has 0 route disputes upheld in 90 d (RD-6 not met).
